grass_tile.prompt: A seamless tileable square texture of short lush farm grass seen from above, soft light even lighting, small subtle tufts, no objects, no borders, edges must tile seamlessly, fills the whole image.

soil_cell.prompt: A seamless tileable square texture of natural matte dark brown tilled farm soil seen from slightly above. Exactly ONE straight horizontal planting ridge runs across the full width through the middle, with a shallow darker furrow at the top and bottom edges, crumbly soil grains and a few tiny pebbles, muted earthy color, not glossy, not orange. No grass, no border, edges tile seamlessly so copies form long continuous rows.

field_frame.prompt: A rectangular farm field border frame made of rustic light wooden planks with small posts at the four corners and a few grass tufts on the outside edge, seen from 3/4 top-down front view, the frame is thin (about 8% of the width) and the entire inside area is EMPTY and fully transparent, the frame fills the whole image edge to edge, suitable for nine-slice scaling with uniform straight sides.
